title: Green synthesis of magnesium oxide nanoparticles using Nigella sativa seed extract: characterization, in vitro antioxidant activities, and wound healing efficacy in streptozotocin-induced diabetic rats
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8193-8205
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07329D, Paper
Open Access

Awatef Elwej, Abir Mhadhbi, Manel Mohammed alzahrani, Hassane oudadesse, Hamadi Fetoui, Naceur Mejri, Samira Jebahi
This study investigated the green synthesis of magnesium oxide nanoparticles (MgO-NPs) using Nigella sativa (N. Sativa) seed extract and evaluated their antioxidant and wound healing properties in diabetic rats.
